name: Runner Extras - TestPage subpage part
brief: Proves a TestPage can drive a subpage PART: read its rows, insert through New(), and see the SubPageLink filter applied.
description: A card page with a lines part is one of the most common shapes in BC, and an AL test reaches the lines through the part (ConfigCard.Lines.New()). The runner's ITestPage.GetPart returned a bare mock whose Creatable is false and whose PageId is 0, so every such New() failed with 'New method failed because Insert is not allowed. Page = , Id = 0' — eight Pageworks tests. The negatives carry the weight: a part must show ONLY the parent row's lines (a part that ignored SubPageLink would still pass an insert-and-read-back test), and a part whose own page declares InsertAllowed = false must refuse New() rather than insert silently, which proves the answer comes from the PART's page and not from the parent card's.
